description: Looks up a transaction by hash on Base mainnet (default) or Base Sepolia: success/failed/pending, block, confirmations, from, to, value and gas. network accepts eip155:8453, base, 8453, eip155:84532, base-sepolia, 84532. A hash unknown to the chain is reported clearly as found:false. ~5 s budget; RPC unavailable fails (not charged). Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.
name: tx.status
title: Transaction status on Base
